text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence from NASA FIRMS, no thermal detections were recorded within the rural property (ASSET-F07) during the period from September 26, 2026, to October 26, 2026. The analysis covered the entire asset boundary using data from multiple sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS), all of which were active throughout the period. The assessment explicitly states that the absence of detections does not confirm that no fire occurred, as small, short-lived, or cool fires could have gone undetected.
